doc:
Post module for the MySocial network
 Handles creation and management of posts and comments
 Implements features like comments, reposts, and quotes

has_flag.doc: Helper: check if a bit is set in a bitfield

set_flag.doc: Helper: set a bit in a bitfield

clear_flag.doc: Helper: clear a bit in a bitfield

post_access_fields.doc: Single match site for [`PostAccess`] field extraction.

allow_comments.doc: Query: check if comments are allowed

allow_reactions.doc: Query: check if reactions are allowed

allow_reposts.doc: Query: check if reposts are allowed

allow_quotes.doc: Query: check if quotes are allowed

allow_tips.doc: Query: check if tips are allowed

is_spt_enabled.doc: Query: check if SPT is enabled for this post

poc_disputes_submitted.doc: Legacy alias used by dispute paths during migration.

has_composition_monetization.doc: Returns true when manifest-based revenue routing is active.

get_spt_id.doc: Get the SPT pool ID for a post

set_spt_id.doc: Internal function to set SPT pool ID (package visibility only)

set_enable_spt.doc: Package helper to flip the SPT opt-in flag (late-enable / create-with-SPT paths).

spot_status_pending.doc: SPoT analysis status sentinels for cross-module use.

has_spot_analysis.doc: Whether an analysis record has been attached to this post yet.

spot_analysis_status.doc: Analysis status; `pending` (0) when no analysis has been attached.

spot_analysis_market_ids.doc: Future-linked market object ids in claim_index order (empty when none/pending).

spot_analysis_claim_indexes.doc: Future-linked claim indexes in ascending order (empty when none/pending).

spot_analysis_claim_ids.doc: Future-linked claim object ids in claim_index order (empty when none/pending).

ensure_spot_analysis_pending.doc: Ensure a `pending` analysis exists so future links can accumulate before finalize.

spot_analysis_append_future.doc: Append one future-claim link (must be pending, strictly increasing claim_index, unique market).

finalize_spot_analysis.doc:
Finalize analysis: validate future vectors, set terminal status, counts and manifests.
 Aborts unless currently pending. Called by the SPoT batch-finalize entry.

bootstrap_init.doc: Bootstrap initialization function - creates the post configuration

convert_urls_to_strings.doc: Convert Option<vector<Url>> to Option<vector<String>> for events

resolve_social_actor.doc: Resolve social actor: capability, principal platform join, block list, and approval gate.

create_post_internal.doc: Internal function to create a post object (not yet shared).

assert_post_access_mydata_binding.doc: Validates registry ownership when a MyData listing is linked on `access`.

assert_post_access_mydata_object_binding.doc: Cross-layer MyData access binding when the listing object is supplied in the PTB.

create_post_entry_body.doc: Create a new post with interaction permissions.

create_post_object_for_spt.doc:
Build an unsared standard post with `enable_spt = true` for SPT create-with-reservation.
 Caller bootstraps the reservation pool, sets `spt_id`, then `share_and_emit_spt_post`.

share_and_emit_spt_post.doc: Set reservation-pool `spt_id`, share the post, and emit `PostCreatedEvent` with SPT fields filled.

create_post.doc: Create a new post; caller supplies access via kind + optional service/mydata ids.

validate_post_mydata_binding.doc: Optional object binding for [`create_post`] when a linked MyData listing is in the PTB.

create_public_post.doc: Create a public post (no subscription or marketplace gate).

create_profile_subscription_post.doc: Create a profile-subscription-gated post (optional linked MyData for encrypted body).

create_profile_subscription_post_with_my.doc: Profile-subscription post with linked MyData object binding in the same PTB.

create_marketplace_one_time_post.doc: Create a marketplace one-time purchase gated post (requires linked MyData listing).

create_comment.doc:
Create a comment on a post or a reply to another comment
 Returns the ID of the created comment

create_repost.doc:
Create a repost or quote repost depending on provided parameters
 If content is provided, it's treated as a quote repost
 If content is empty/none, it's treated as a standard repost

delete_post.doc: Delete a post owned by the caller

delete_comment.doc: Delete a comment owned by the caller

react_to_post.doc:
React to a post with a specific reaction (emoji or text)
 If the user already has the exact same reaction, it will be removed (toggle behavior)

tip_post.doc:
Tip a post creator with coin type `T`. When manifest entries use escrow payout mode for this
 `amount`, `beneficiary_vault` must match the beneficiary's shared vault.

tip_post_simple.doc:
Like [`tip_post`] but without a `PoCBeneficiaryVault` argument. Only for posts where
 [`tip_post_requires_beneficiary_vault_for_amount`] is false for this `amount`.
 If an escrow deposit is required, aborts with [`ETipPostRequiresBeneficiaryVault`].

apply_revenue_manifest_coin.doc: Manifest-based revenue split for tips and fees on the creator-attributable pool.

apply_revenue_manifest_coin_without_bene.doc: Same as [`apply_revenue_manifest_coin`] for tip paths that never deposit into escrow for this `amount`.

record_embedded_bindings.doc: Oracle records embedded asset bindings detected during composition analysis.

refresh_post_asset_usage_decision.doc: Oracle refreshes a usage decision snapshot for one binding (requires live `MediaAsset`).

submit_candidate_revenue_manifest.doc: Oracle submits a candidate revenue manifest for indexer materialization.

deny_container_usage.doc: Rights holder denies container-scoped usage on this post for one binding.

lift_container_usage_denial.doc: Rights holder lifts a container-scoped denial for one binding and scope.

set_composition_result.doc: Internal function to store composition analysis + optional revenue manifest (oracle-only).

clear_composition_data.doc: Clears composition routing data on the post after dispute resolution (vault balances are unaffected).

clear_poc_data.doc: Legacy alias for dispute paths during migration.

increment_composition_disputes_submitted.doc: Increment after each successful composition dispute submission.

increment_poc_disputes_submitted.doc: Legacy alias for dispute paths during migration.

deposit_coin_to_beneficiary_vault.doc: Deposit manifest-routed fees into the beneficiary vault when the post uses escrow payout mode.

tip_repost.doc:
Tip a repost or quote repost; splits per `PostConfig` between repost owner and original author.
 Pass the shared `PoCBeneficiaryVault` for each post when manifest entries use escrow payout mode.

tip_comment.doc: Tip a comment; split per `PostConfig` with manifest-based routing on the post owner's share.

tip_comment_simple.doc:
Like [`tip_comment`] but without a `PoCBeneficiaryVault` / Clock / min vault deposit.
 Only for posts where [`tip_post_requires_beneficiary_vault_for_amount`] is false for the
 **post-owner slice** of this tip. If an escrow deposit is required, aborts with
 [`ETipPostRequiresBeneficiaryVault`].

transfer_post_ownership.doc: Transfer post ownership to another user (by post owner)

admin_transfer_post_ownership.doc: Admin function to transfer post ownership (requires PostAdminCap)

react_to_comment.doc:
React to a comment with a specific reaction (emoji or text)
 If the user already has the exact same reaction, it will be removed (toggle behavior)

edit_post.doc: Edit a post through the delegated-agent authorization model.

edit_comment.doc: Edit a comment through the delegated-agent authorization model.

remove_post_reaction.doc: Remove the caller principal's current post reaction without toggle semantics.

remove_comment_reaction.doc: Remove the caller principal's current comment reaction without toggle semantics.

remove_repost.doc: Remove a repost and decrement its original post's aggregate count.

get_id_address.doc: Get the ID address of a post

get_reaction_count.doc: Get the reaction count of a post

get_tips_received.doc: Get the tips received for a post

get_comment_tips_received.doc: Get the tips received for a comment (commenter share of tip_comment / tip_comment_simple).

get_platform_id.doc: Get the platform ID for a post

get_revenue_redirect_to.doc: Get the revenue redirect address for a post (legacy compat stub — always none).

get_revenue_redirect_percentage.doc: Get the revenue redirect percentage for a post (legacy compat stub — always none).

poc_redirection_kind.doc: Legacy compat — derived from cached revenue manifest payout modes.

poc_redirection_none.doc: Legacy compat stub for fee-routing callers during migration.

version.doc: Get the version of a post

borrow_version_mut.doc: Get a mutable reference to the post version (for upgrade module)

comment_version.doc: Get the version of a comment

borrow_comment_version_mut.doc: Get a mutable reference to the comment version (for upgrade module)

repost_version.doc: Get the version of a repost

borrow_repost_version_mut.doc: Get a mutable reference to the repost version (for upgrade module)

create_promoted_post.doc: Create a promoted post with MYSO tokens for viewer payments

confirm_promoted_post_views.doc:
Confirm that one viewer was paid for N (≥1) promoted post views in a single transaction.
 Takes promotions by value (MakeMoveVec), merges nets into one transfer, then re-shares each
 `PromotionData`. Fees come out of each view's `payment_per_view` gross.

toggle_promotion_status.doc:
Toggle promotion status (platform can activate, both platform and owner can deactivate)
 Use with activate: false to deactivate promotions

withdraw_promotion_funds.doc: Withdraw all MYSO tokens from promotion (owner only, deactivates promotion)

get_promotion_stats.doc: Get promotion statistics for a post

has_user_viewed_promoted_post.doc: Check if a user has already been paid for viewing a promoted post

get_promotion_id.doc: Get the promotion ID from a post

set_moderation_status.doc: Set moderation status for a post (platform devs/mods only)

is_content_approved.doc: Check if content is approved (not flagged)

assert_can_view_post.doc: Abort unless caller is post owner or holds a valid profile subscription for the gated service.

record_post_subscription_view.doc: Record a subscriber view after access check; emits `PostSubscriptionAccessEvent`.

create_post_admin_cap.doc:
Create a PostAdminCap for bootstrap (package visibility only)
 This function is only callable by other modules in the same package

Post.doc: Post object that contains content information

media.doc: Display/cache URLs — not authoritative for PoC.

PostAttribution.doc: Published-action attribution stored as a dynamic field (Post is at the VM field-count limit).

EmbeddedAssetBinding.doc: Phase 4 — embedded asset binding on a post container.

PostSpotAnalysis.doc:
Per-post multi-claim SPoT analysis, attached to `post.id` via `SPOT_ANALYSIS_DF_KEY`.
 Future-claim links are stored as aligned vectors (index/claim/market/policy); past
 verdict detail lives off-chain (indexer/oracle) and is committed here only as counts
 and manifest hashes.

Comment.doc: Comment object for posts, supporting nested comments

post_id.doc: The post this comment belongs to

parent_comment_id.doc: Optional parent comment ID for nested comments

profile_id.doc: Commenter's profile ID (reference only, not ownership)

tips_received.doc: Total tips received in MYSO (tracking only, not actual balance)

removed_from_platform.doc: Whether the comment has been removed from its platform

user_reactions.doc: Table of user wallet addresses to their reactions (emoji or text)

reaction_counts.doc: Table to count reactions by type

is_original_post.doc: Whether the original is a post (true) or comment (false)

profile_id.doc: Reposter's profile ID (reference only, not ownership)

payment_per_view.doc: Amount of MYSO to pay per view

paid_viewers.doc: Table tracking which users have already been paid for viewing

views.doc: List of all views for analytics

active.doc: Whether the promotion is currently active

max_content_length.doc: Maximum character length for post content

max_media_urls.doc: Maximum number of media URLs per post

max_mentions.doc: Maximum number of mentions in a post

max_metadata_size.doc: Maximum size for post metadata in bytes

commenter_tip_percentage.doc: Percentage of tip that goes to commenter (remainder to post owner)

repost_tip_percentage.doc: Percentage of tip that goes to reposter (remainder to original post owner)

min_promotion_amount.doc: Minimum payment per view for promoted posts (MIST)

max_promotion_amount.doc: Maximum payment per view for promoted posts (MIST)

min_view_duration_ms.doc: Minimum view duration for a promoted post view to count (ms)

platform_fee_bps.doc: Platform fee bps taken from each confirmed promo view gross

ecosystem_fee_bps.doc: Ecosystem fee bps taken from each confirmed promo view gross

PostParametersUpdatedEvent.doc: Event emitted when post parameters are updated

min_promotion_amount.doc: New min promotion amount value (MIST per view)

max_promotion_amount.doc: New max promotion amount value (MIST per view)

platform_fee_bps.doc: New platform fee bps of each promo view gross

ecosystem_fee_bps.doc: New ecosystem fee bps of each promo view gross

RepostRemovedEvent.doc: Repost removal event with principal and delegated-agent attribution.

PromotedPostCreatedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a promoted post is created

PromotedViewConfirmItem.doc: One item inside a batch promoted-view confirmation

payment_amount.doc: Gross debit from this promotion's budget (`payment_per_view`)

recipient_amount.doc: Net attributed to this view (part of the merged wallet transfer)

PromotedPostViewsBatchConfirmedEvent.doc: Event emitted when one viewer is paid for N (≥1) promoted views in a single tx

PromotionStatusToggledEvent.doc: Event emitted when promotion status is toggled

PromotionFundsWithdrawnEvent.doc: Event emitted when promotion funds are withdrawn

ModerationRecord.doc: Simple moderation record for tracking moderation decisions

PostAccess.doc: Post content access model (replaces legacy `mydata_id` + subscription gate dynamic field).
